Texture credits
===============

Every texture under assets/textures/ is listed here as: "Title" by Author - Source - License.

"crate.png" - generated by the agent for the OBJ gun spike (V4) - own work, no external license
    32 x 32 checker of 4 px squares; the magenta 2 x 2 corner at the top left shows flips
"wall_test.png" - generated by the agent for the OBJ gun spike (V5) - own work, no external license
    32 x 32 grey bricks (16 x 8 px); the magenta 2 x 2 corner at the top left shows flips
